title: Asset and audio spend ledger (.gamestudio/budget.json)
description: Spending cap and append-only ledger of paid generation calls. studio-gateway refuses any call whose estimated cost would push spent_usd above cap_usd. spent_usd should equal the sum of ledger cost_usd values (JSON Schema cannot check sums; tools should flag drift).

cap_usd.description: Spending cap in USD for this project (from config.budgets.asset_usd_cap or the plugin default).

spent_usd.description: Total spent so far in USD; the sum of ledger cost_usd.

ledger.description: Append-only list of charges, oldest first. Never edit or delete past entries; add a correcting entry instead.

items.description: One paid (or zero-cost mock) generation call.

tool.description: studio-gateway tool name that spent the money, e.g. "image_generate", "audio_sfx".

cost_usd.description: Charged or estimated cost in USD. Normally >= 0; a negative value is only allowed for a correcting entry (refund or over-estimate) and needs a note.

asset_ids.description: Manifest asset ids produced by the call.

note.description: Context: batch name, whether the cost is estimated or billed, corrections.
